html: Designs online LLM selection and routing methods that learn from limited user feedback, combining bandit learning, user studies and large-scale evaluation, and builds humanoid robotics pipelines on the Unitree G1 and Go2 for teleoperation, demonstration collection, behavior cloning and policy evaluation.

Built a GPT-style multimodal model that fuses surgical video and kinematics to forecast robot end-effector trajectories (<5 mm RMSE one second ahead), and an AR surgical-training simulator that improved gesture recognition and skill assessment by 18%.
detail: MAPLE Lab, advised by Prof. Jie Ying Wu

html: Fine-tuned GPT-2, Falcon, RWKV and CodeT5 for text-to-SQL with QLoRA, and built a reproducible benchmarking framework to compare data-efficient adaptation strategies.
Combined BERT on clinical text with ResNet-50 on chest images for lung-disease diagnosis, reaching 0.91 micro-F1 and cutting diagnosis time by 90%.
